base_rule: Current main plus accepted admission repair only if required; no installed payload edits.

finding.behavior: Current --apply reads/plans then calls Path.write_text on owned state without lock, temporary file, fsync or atomic replace. Partial failure can truncate durable state; concurrent serialized intentions can race on the same starting snapshot.
finding.evidence_status: Static source confirmed; independent failure injection required before repair.

non_goals: No new receipt/attempt authority or completion state schema
No bypass of plan_receipt_transition or existing proof validation
No live state migration, production operation or .nizam modification
proposed_behavior: Read-only resume stays write-free and does not create a lock.
Apply validates target state and serializes read-plan-write under one per-state OS lock; every contender replans from locked current bytes.
For advance, publish complete JSON to same-directory exclusive temp, preserve regular-file permissions, fsync file, atomic replace target, fsync directory; incomplete temp cannot replace valid state.
Noop/republish retains owned state bytes and records the actual outcome without duplicate history.
On interrupted publication, exact replay uses existing receipt verification; no attempt reset, replay counter or new state store.
Reject symlink/nonregular publication targets and preserve unrelated files.
acceptance: Independent real interruption before replace preserves old parseable state; interruption after replace yields complete new parseable state.
Two concurrent apply calls on same valid receipt yield exactly one history transition and one noop.
Concurrent conflicting receipts cannot both advance from stale source state.
Read-only run has no filesystem effects, old/new mode preserved, failure refuses with evidence and does not mark applied.
Existing real receipt/recovery and task-wide retry cases remain passing.

verification.acceptance_test: Missing receipt recovery preserves original state

execution_prerequisite: Independent Test Engineer RED plus ModeA and independent evaluator contract review; actual runtime fault injection must discriminate atomicity without assuming an implementation-specific helper name.
scope_note: The owning contract exact file scope and seven-command verification inventory supersede optional paths in the earlier external concept proposal. No test_start_path.py or tools/interface.md mutation is authorized by this task.

ci_wiring.reason: Current workflows execute none of test_nf_ac*, test_start_path or new resume suite, so green CI does not protect these source fixes. Workflow path is normative under installed classifier; no lightweight bypass.
invariants: Same existing fixtures_self_test job, runner and permissions
